title: fix(pm): derive the gates that re-derive from a package export surface
body:
Fixes #13518

## The reading, re-derived on this branch's base (`987fe370`, after PR #13862 / #14012 / #14188)

The card's premise still held. Its own re-check, run on a fresh tree:

```
node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/spec/src/index.ts
```

| gate | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `check:api-surface` | absent | matched |
| `check:export-origins` | absent | matched |
| `check:entry-nameability` | absent | matched |
| `check:exported-any` | absent | matched |
| `check:dual-source-exports` | absent | matched |
| `check:browser-reachable-entries` | absent | matched |
| `check:strictness-ledger` (positive control) | present | present |

33 matched families before, 39 after. The control was present in both runs, which is what makes the six an absence rather than a dead query.

## Why the whole CLASS fell out of the derivation

Not six defects. Every one of the six re-derives its population from `@objectstack/spec`'s **public export surface**, and none of them spells that surface as a path. Each reads `packages/spec/package.json`, walks its `exports` map, and resolves each subpath into a built `dist/*.d.ts`. So the population is computed through the manifest, and both places a literal could have carried it fail:

- `dist/` is a build **output** and untracked, so any literal reaching it dies in the reachability sweep by construction;
- the literals these gates do write are anchored at a **package root** (`resolve(PKG_DIR, 'src/index.ts')`), and `extractWatchHints` resolves against exactly one anchor -- the writer's own directory. A literal with no `./` prefix is taken from the repo root, so `'src/index.ts'` becomes the root hint `src/index.ts` and reaches nothing.

The derivation models three follows -- import, program-text read, exec -- and all three end at a **program** whose declared population can be inherited. A package manifest is not a program. So the entire class ended at a manifest read that contributed nothing, and each of the six scored `silent` with only its helper-module imports as population.

That this is a class and not a story is printed on other gates today: `check:generated`'s dead leads are `api-surface`, `export-origins` and `src/meta-spelling/...` -- three literals alive under `packages/spec/` and dead at the root.

## The repair: an EDGE, not six names

⛔ No gate name is added to any table. Following the pattern PR #14012 established for exec edges, this adds the **fourth follow -- the manifest edge** -- routed through the same three pieces and adding none:

- the followed file's **own declaration** decides what a caller inherits. For a module that is `declaredInheritedPopulation`; for a manifest it is the `exports` map, read from the tree rather than from a regex over the gate's prose;
- `hintOrigin` / `hintEdge` label the inherited hint so it never travels as a claim the gate made itself. The via column reads `gate source via the export surface declared by packages/spec/package.json`;
- it is appended **last**, after own, imported and run hints, so it can only fill a hole.

A second, smaller hop was required by one member: `build-export-origins.ts` reaches its package root through a **function parameter** (`collectSourceEntries(pkgDir)`), where the others use a constant. `singleCallSiteParameters` reads a parameter bound at exactly one call site -- the same one-hop shape `singleReturnExpressions` already uses. It is consulted **only** where nothing binds the name, which is the branch that returned `unknown` before, so it can add a reading and can never move one.

### The narrowing that decides the number

A gate must actually **read the `exports` map** to follow the edge. Without that test the edge admits every reader of any manifest -- +1678 pairs on this tree, every one fabricated. The three live refusals, each checked at its own declaration site:

| gate | reads | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `check:docs-image-tag` | `packages/cli/package.json` -> `.version` | refused (235 fabricated pairs withdrawn) |
| `check:authorable-surface` | `packages/spec/package.json` -> `.version` | refused |
| `check:generated` | `packages/spec/package.json` -> the `scripts` map | refused |

`check:generated` is under-matched for `packages/spec/src` for the *other* reason above (package-root-anchored literals dying at the root). That is a different defect and is filed separately rather than fixed here under a test it does not pass.

## Does a seventh gate of the class get covered automatically?

Yes, and it is demonstrated two ways rather than argued:

1. **A live seventh gate the card never named.** `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` walks the same `exports` map and `require()`s every published entry (#12971). It is picked up by the edge with nothing listing it. It gains no *pairs* -- its CI job filter is `packages/**` and already covered them -- it gains the right *provenance*, and the self-test pins it by name.
2. **An eighth that exists nowhere but the case.** The self-test writes a gate in the class shape, in no table anywhere, and asserts it inherits the same population.

## Blast radius, measured before and after

Over 199 discovered families x 7762 tracked files, counted through `coveringKey` -- the same key the printed block renders from:

```
(family, file) pairs the derivation covers   166173 -> 172797  (+6624)
pairs LOST                                                          0
pairs RE-ATTRIBUTED (same pair, new via)                            0
families whose VERDICT changes                                      6
```

The six take 1104 pairs each -- the whole of `packages/spec/src`, once, which is the defect exactly. No family outside the class moves in either direction.

## Verification (all at `f2b1d1fa`)

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is a gate script, so its own self-test is owed on top of the derived family:

| command | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` | **1110 cases pass, 0 fail** -- 20 of them added by this diff |
| `node scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs --self-test` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:declared-population-live` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:watch-hint-literal` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:entry-guard` / `check:parse-guard` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` + `node scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling` / `check:bash32-floor` / `check:cli-command-ids` / `check:pnpm-filter-targets` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:nul-bytes` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs` | **NOT MEASURED** -- it needs a saved `turbo run test` log; run bare it exits 3 and its own text says to record it as not measured |

The family list was derived from the actual diff with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (no path arguments -- the script takes its own change set), not quoted from the card.

Every exit code above was captured before any pipe. Two `exit=3` readings on the first pass (`check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-shard-attestation`) were PREREQUISITE NOT MET -- a fresh worktree with no `node_modules` -- and are recorded green above only after `pnpm install` and a re-run.

### Both directions pinned

The 15 new self-test cases pin the repair and its refusals, not that a derivation ran:

- the six derive for `packages/spec/src/index.ts`, and the control still does;
- **and none of the six reaches that path on anything it spells itself** -- without this half every case above passes on a key the gate already had, which is the reading that would let someone "fix" this by widening an unrelated literal;
- the via column names the export surface, not a population the gate declares;
- the identical manifest read with the `exports` read removed contributes nothing;
- a manifest read inside a self-test body is a fixture, not the gate reaching a package;
- a parameter with **two** call sites contributes nothing rather than a pick;
- `entry.manifests` is exactly what the scan finds over the family's own files -- never a list kept in the file;
- the live tree really has gates reading a manifest without reading its exports (6 gate files), and not one inherits a package source.

20 cases in total, counted from the diff. The pre-change baseline was not separately measured, so no before/after case count is claimed -- only that the suite is green at `f2b1d1fa` with 0 failures.

## No changeset

The diff is one file under `scripts/pm/**` and publishes nothing from any package, so `skip-changeset` applies and the label is set on this PR.

## Note for review

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is the board's single-writer toolchain file. No open PR claimed it when this branch started -- re-checked against all 8 open PRs immediately before the first push.
